title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris
overview: Capturing Katy Perry’s electrifying, immersive concert experience, Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris blends powerhouse performances, exhilarating cinematography, and intimate moments to bring audiences into the spectacular world of this creative artist.

title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

title: Mutiny
overview: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

title: Girls Like Girls
overview: After her mother's passing, 17-year-old Coley navigates new feelings of intimacy with Sonya in rural Oregon, where both girls must overcome their mutual uncertainties and self-doubt to embrace their connection.

title: In the Name of Love
overview: Follows a modern-day writer who slips back in time, inhabiting the body of Wanthong from the Thai classic Khun Chang Khun Phaen, and struggles to rewrite her destiny and avoid a tragic fate.

title: All Wishes Come True!
overview: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.

title: Hope
overview: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

title: Are We Monsters?
overview: A gay radical outsider, a flamboyant Muslim, and a nasty single mom live in a devout Muslim area on the Thai border under decades of martial law.

title: Practical Magic 2
overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

title: Blue Lock
overview: A secret training program is established by the Japan Football Union to scout the world’s greatest striker after several years of defeat for the national team. Three hundred high school players gather at a remote facility to compete in ruthless trials where only one will emerge as the world’s greatest and most egoistic striker. The price of failure is absolute: those eliminated are permanently banned from ever joining the National Team.

title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

title: Legend of the White Dragon
overview: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

title: The Rivals of Amziah King
overview: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

title: Henry's First Dates
overview: Lucy, a woman who's living her first date on repeat with Henry, a good-natured, animal-loving guy with a bizarre condition: every time he wakes up, he can't remember anything from the day before.

title: It Ends
overview: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

title: NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY  SEOUL - THE REDLINE’ in CINEMAS
overview: Back after almost two years, NCT 127's fifth tour,  NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY : SEOUL - THE REDLINE’, is coming live to cinemas!  Experience the explosive energy, world-class performances, and electrifying atmosphere of KSPO DOME brought to life on the big screen with immersive sound.  NCTzens, join us for the spectacular kickoff of 'THE REDLINE'!

title: Heart of the Beast
overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

title: The Cycle
overview: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

title: Resident Evil
overview: Medical courier Bryan unwittingly finds himself fighting for survival as one fateful, horrifying night collapses around him in chaos.

title: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast
overview: Follows the search for a missing military officer in the jungle of Khao Khwang, where legend says man-eating tiger spirit Saming takes human form in 1960s Thailand.
